_nota: Pagine «NAICS code for …»: pubblicate solo se una delle frasi ha un volume in volumi.json. Le voci elencate vengono dall'indice ufficiale 2022 (regex su «INDEX ITEM DESCRIPTION»); i testi introduttivi sono nostri e citano solo titoli ufficiali (genera.py li controlla).

attivita.titolo: NAICS Code for Consulting: All Official Consulting Codes
attivita.descrizione: Which NAICS code fits a consulting business: every consulting activity in the official 2022 index, grouped by code, with the SIC equivalents.
attivita.intro: Consulting has no single NAICS code: the code follows the kind of advice. The official 2022 index of the Census Bureau lists {n_voci} consulting activities in {n_codici} different codes; most are in industry group 5416 «{t_5416}».

attivita.titolo: NAICS Code for Construction and General Contractors
attivita.h1: NAICS code for construction and general contractors
attivita.descrizione: Construction is NAICS sector 23: all 31 six-digit codes, which code fits a general contractor, and the old SIC construction codes.
attivita.intro: Construction is NAICS sector 23 «{t_23}», with {n_sei_23} six-digit industries in three subsectors. The code follows the main type of work: what is built (houses, other buildings, roads and utilities) or which trade is done. In the official index, general contractors appear in {n_codici} codes, by type of building.

attivita.titolo: NAICS Code for Cleaning Services: Janitorial, Carpet, Laundry
attivita.descrizione: Which NAICS code fits a cleaning business: janitorial, maid, carpet, window, chimney and laundry services, from the official 2022 index.
attivita.intro: Cleaning services are spread over several NAICS codes, depending on what is cleaned. The official 2022 index lists {n_voci} cleaning activities in {n_codici} codes; cleaning of buildings and homes is in industry group 5617 «{t_5617}».
